text: ok now let me ask is the encoder following the @GUIDING_LIGHT.md methodology
resolution: User asked whether the encoder follows GUIDING_LIGHT — it did not, and that was the real fix. The game-file artifact is GL-compliant packed binary, but the bake handed it to the CLI as base64-in-JSON on stdout (then shell 'base64 -d' back to bytes) — exactly the table row 'Use JSON/base64 → Pack binary, zero-copy; data IS the load format', and the text inflate pass is what OOM'd. Held the line: added __fs_write_bytes (a zero-copy Uint8Array→disk fs door reusing the image_ops backing-store pattern) + writeFileBytes JS wrapper; new shared emitGameFile.ts writes the binary game-file + content-addressed asset blobs straight to disk (paths via --gamefile/--store argv) and prints only a manifest; rewrote installGameFileEnvelope→installGameFileManifest in the CLI. Rebuilt v8cli + rebundled rjit.js. No base64/JSON megabytes anywhere. NOT committed (parallel-session contamination in bakeGameFile.ts).
